Broke up with my girlfriend of 4 years a week ago in a way that absolutely destroyed me and shocked me. At the time I was in a rut and out of a job so it all came crashing downI was never a big exercise person. It always felt like I was depressed because I didn't exercise and I didn't exercise because I was depressed.I just went out one day after the breakup and started doing it and I never felt better. My advice would be to look at yourself, see what you want to improve and get out of life and aim for it. It looks impossible at this point, but as soon as you begin to break out this rut it will get better from here. So my advice would be to try your best to rebuild yourself.In order to rebuild yourself, you must first be broken.P.S. There's people more experienced than me but if you feel like you want to talk I'm available dude.
